title: Journal v2: schema-validated events, run index, and a replay digest
summary: The journal stops being a loose JSONL buffer and becomes a validated, indexed, replayable event log. `journal.rs` is split into five modules: `event.rs` (the envelope, actor/cost/evidence types, and ten payload types), `hash.rs` (the chain digest plus a new replay digest over decision fields only), `schema.rs` (a compiled JSON Schema validator run on every append), `index.rs` (a per-work-item run index under `<state_dir>/index`, guarded by an advisory file lock), and `reader.rs` (a strict reader that verifies every link before returning any event). The buffer directory is renamed to `runs`, run ids are validated as safe single path components, and a run-complete event must name the journal's current head hash and closes the run to further writes.

nodes.label: Checkpoint runner
nodes.subtitle: osf verify --checkpoint
nodes.summary: Runs the tagged moon tasks and writes one verification event per task plus a checkpoint-complete event. Now builds an `Actor::system("osf")` and fills the new `check_type`, `summary` and typed `EvidenceGrade` fields.

nodes.label: Review run
nodes.subtitle: osf review
nodes.summary: Writes review-answer and review-decision events. Updated to pass an `Actor` value rather than a bare actor string.

nodes.label: Journal writer
nodes.subtitle: Journal::append / append_draft
nodes.summary: Computes the chain hash, validates the serialised event against the schema, records the run in its work-item index on the first accepted event, and appends one JSON line. A refused event writes no byte and leaves the head unchanged; a run-complete event closes the journal.

nodes.label: Event model
nodes.subtitle: event.rs
nodes.summary: The envelope (run, work item, change, actor, timestamp, cost, payload, prev_hash, hash) and ten payload types, with typed `ActorKind`, `EvidenceGrade`, `Severity`, `WorkItemState`, `BlockedCause` and `RunOutcome` enums.

nodes.label: Hash chain
nodes.subtitle: hash.rs
nodes.summary: SHA-256 over prev_hash, a newline, and the canonical JSON of payload, work item, change, actor and cost. Adds `ReplayDigest`, a second digest over decision fields only, which drops timings, cache outcomes, cost, run ids and transcripts.

nodes.label: Schema validator
nodes.subtitle: schema.rs + event.schema.json
nodes.summary: Compiles the draft 2020-12 event schema once per process and checks every event before it is written, returning one reason per problem. The schema encodes the cross-field rules: a harness actor must name a model, a blocked state change must carry a cause, and only observed evidence may name a verifier.

nodes.label: Run index
nodes.subtitle: index.rs
nodes.summary: One JSON file per work item under `<state_dir>/index`, named by the SHA-256 of the work item id, listing that item's run ids in recorded order. Writes go through a temporary file renamed over the target, under an advisory lock taken with fs4.

nodes.label: Journal reader
nodes.subtitle: reader.rs
nodes.summary: Reads a run back, checking each line against the schema and each link against the chain, and returns no events at all if any line fails. Reports the head hash, the replay digest, and whether the run completed.

nodes.label: runs/
nodes.subtitle: <run>.jsonl
nodes.summary: The per-run journal file, one JSON event per line. Renamed from `buffer/`; the CI evidence upload and every test helper follow the new name.

nodes.label: index/
nodes.subtitle: <sha256>.json + .lock
nodes.summary: Per-work-item run lists, plus the lock file beside each. Created only when a journal carries a work item.

nodes.label: CI evidence upload
nodes.subtitle: checkpoint-evidence artifact
nodes.summary: Uploads the state directory's run journals and `.osf/out` as the checkpoint evidence artifact; the path moved from `buffer` to `runs`.

nodes.label: Journal tests
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf/tests
nodes.summary: Checkpoint, hook and review-run integration tests read the journal from `runs/` and assert the new optional-field behaviour, such as a could-not-run decision omitting score and threshold rather than writing null.

edges.label: append(actor, payload)
edges.summary: The checkpoint runner hands each verification and the checkpoint-complete event to the writer, which now validates before writing.

edges.label: append(Actor::system)
edges.summary: Review answers and the review decision go through the same validated append path.
The writer builds an `Event` from an `EventDraft` and the journal's run, work item and change.

edges.label: event_hash(HashInput)
edges.summary: The chain hash now covers the work item, change, actor and cost alongside the payload.

edges.label: validate(event)
edges.summary: Every event is checked against the schema before any byte is written; a failure returns the reasons and leaves the chain head untouched.

edges.label: record_run(work_item, run)
edges.summary: The first accepted event of a run with a work item records that run in the item's index before the journal line lands.

edges.label: temp file + rename
edges.summary: The index is written through a temporary sibling renamed over the target, so a reader never sees a half-written list.
The reader loads the run's journal file and checks every line before returning anything.

edges.label: recompute + ReplayDigest
edges.summary: Each line's hash is recomputed from its own fields, and the replay digest is accumulated over the decision fields.
A line that is schema-invalid is reported as invalid even when its hash is correct.

edges.label: artifact path
edges.summary: The evidence artifact now collects `runs/` instead of `buffer/`.
Integration tests locate the run's journal under `runs/` and parse its lines.

flows.title: Appending one validated event
flows.summary: What happens between a caller handing over a payload and a line landing in the run's journal, including the two ways the write is refused.

messages.label: event_hash over payload, work item, change, actor, cost
reasons: no byte written, head unchanged
messages.note: A run-complete event whose head_hash is not the journal's current head is refused here too, and a run already complete refuses every later event.

messages.label: record_run(work_item, run)
messages.note: Only on the first accepted event of a run that carries a work item; a failed index update refuses the event before any journal line is written.

flows.title: Reading a run back and verifying it
flows.summary: The reader checks every line against the schema and every link against the chain, and returns either the whole run or one error naming the offending line.

messages.label: validate(line)
messages.note: One call per line; a schema-invalid line is reported as invalid even when its hash is correct.

messages.label: ReplayDigest over decision fields
messages.note: The replay digest ignores timings, cache outcomes, cost, run ids and transcripts, so two runs with the same decisions share it while their chain heads differ.

messages.label: RunJournal { events, head_hash, replay_digest, complete }
messages.note: Any failure returns that line's error and no events at all, so a caller never sees a partial chain.

steps.heading: The journal grew up
steps.body: One module became five, and the buffer became a validated run log.

steps.heading: Append is now a gate
steps.body: Hash, validate, index, then write; a refusal leaves no byte behind.

steps.heading: Read verifies before it returns
steps.body: Every line is schema-checked and every link recomputed, or nothing comes back.

steps.heading: Two hashes, two jobs
steps.body: The chain head proves the file is intact; the replay digest proves the decisions repeat.
